camel_example: aliyun sas OperateAgentClientInstall --region cn-hangzhou --Os linux --Region 'cn-hangzhou' --Lang en --InstanceIds 'i-uf6j8vq9l4r5ntht0000' --Uuids '1587bedb-fdb4-48c4-9330-000000000000'
description_en: Installs the Security Center agent on servers
description_zh: 为服务器安装云安全中心Agent插件
kebab_example: aliyun sas operate-agent-client-install --instance-ids i-uf6j8vq9l4r5ntht0000 --uuids 1587bedb-fdb4-48c4-9330-000000000000 --lang en --biz-region cn-hangzhou --os linux --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: OperateAgentClientInstall

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the servers on which you want to install the Security Center agent. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).

: You must specify at least one of InstanceIds and Uuids. If you specify InstanceIds, you must also specify Region and Os
parameters.help_zh:
要安装云安全中心Agent的服务器实例的ID列表，多个实例ID之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。

InstanceIds、Uuids这两个参数二选一，必须设置一个，才可以成功调用本接口，如果选择InstanceIds，则Region和Os必填
parameters.name: instance_ids

parameters.help_en:
The UUIDs of the servers on which you want to install the Security Center agent. Separate multiple UUIDs with commas (,).

You must specify at least one of the InstanceIds and Uuids parameters before you can call this operation
parameters.help_zh:
要安装的服务器的UUID列表，多个UUID之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。

InstanceIds、Uuids这两个参数二选一，必须设置一个，才可以成功调用本接口
parameters.name: uuids

parameters.help_en:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: zh. Valid values:

zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为zh。取值：
zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The region where the servers reside. Valid values include the following regions:

cn-hangzhou: China (Hangzhou)
cn-beijing: China (Beijing)
cn-shanghai: China (Shanghai)
cn-zhangjiakou: China (Zhangjiakou)
cn-shenzhen: China (Shenzhen)
parameters.help_zh:
机器所在地域，包括但不限于如下地域：

cn-hangzhou：杭州

cn-beijing：北京

cn-shanghai：上海

cn-zhangjiakou：张家口

cn-shenzhen：深圳
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en:
The operating system of the servers. Valid values:

linux
windows
parameters.help_zh:
实例的操作系统。取值：

linux：linux

windows：windows
parameters.name: os
